name: Patricio Worthalter
rootCause: The address of Patricio Worthalter, founder of POAP, was attacked by phishing. The attacker transferred 85,898 RPL (approximately $3.83 million) from Worthalter’s address to DEX, and sold all RPL at a price of 1,802 ETH (approximately $3.25 million). price drop.
